name: Stargaze
source:
Ascend to a higher existence. Accept reality.

An eldritch horror story about a small town plagued by frequent meteor strikes. They say anyone who touches a meteorite disappears without a trace.

When our narrator meets a strange girl obsessed with these meteories, her entire reality shatters before her.

[From [url=https://cinnamatsu.itch.io/stargaze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
提升到更高的存在。接受现实。

这是一个关于一个经常遭受流星袭击的小镇的恐怖故事。他们说任何接触陨石的人都会消失得无影无踪。

当我们的叙述者遇到一个痴迷于这些流星的奇怪女孩时，她的整个现实在她面前破碎了。

[来自[url=https://cinnamatsu.itch.io/stargaze]itch.io[/url]]
